title: In the Songs of Blood and Sword ‘Baloch aspired to be as independent as Nepal’ - Khabarhub
description: In the Songs of Blood and Sword ‘Baloch aspired to be as independent as Nepal’  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
Severe tensions in Balochistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Pakistan-administered Kashmir (PAK) have created a situation akin to a civil war, although a civil war has not been formally declared in Pakistan. The southwestern province of Pakistan has been in conflict for decades, and a document allegedly issued in the name of the ‘Republic of Balochistan’ has spurred new discussions.

Reportedly, eighty-five percent of the regions are under the authority of Baloch who have declared their independence. Nevertheless, the assertions stated in the purported independence paper have not yet been independently confirmed. Since 2003, there has been persistent unrest and separatist movements in Balochistan, driven by demands for independence and autonomy. The Baloch people have a distinct language and culture. They feel neglected by Pakistan’s Punjabi-dominated political and military establishment.

Fatima Bhutto’s book ‘Songs of Blood and Sword’ offers an engrossing historical narrative of the Baloch people’s quest for independence from Pakistan and Balochistan as a separate nation similar to Nepal. This book is mainly based on the epic story of the Bhuttos, a family of wealthy feudal landlords who rose to prominence in the newly formed state of Pakistan, is told in Songs of Blood and Sword.

It is the story of four generations of a family and the political violence that would ultimately kill them. Written by someone who has experienced it, it is the story of a family and country torn apart by murder, corruption, conspiracy, and division.

Published in 2010, this 470-page book provides a contemporary perspective on history and how it impacts the military’s political ambitions in Pakistan. Overall, this book is useful for comprehending Pakistan’s future status and course.

Independent like Nepal

Pakistan has had a significant impact on the province of Balochistan. Depending on who you ask, the Baloch people, who are tribal in their formation and groupings, are claimed to have Semitic or Iranian ancestry. Those who speak Balochi or one of the other regional languages assert that they left their lives as shepherds in Syria sometime in the first millennium and travelled nomadically throughout Central Asia before settling in the Baloch province, while those who identify linguistically with Aryans across the border claim Persian ancestry.

Shahbaz Sharif, the “de jure Prime Minister,” appears to be compelled to behave in accordance with the Pakistan Army’s strategic roadmap. Can the Pakistani elite— have suffered the anguish of Pakistan’s disintegration, stop the Baloch independence movement? Can it alleviate the severe annoyances that the people of PoK and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa are expressing?

Fatima Bhutto, in her book, discusses the independent status of ‘Nepal’ in the context of discussing the Baloch under Pakistan. For decades, Balochistanis have been fighting for independence from Pakistan, even today. During the British Raj, Balochistan was part of the Mughal, Persian, and Afghan kingdoms and was culturally, linguistically, and ethnically integrated with their populations.

By the nineteenth century, most of the four princely states there had been brought under the rule of the British Raj. Wars and imperialist struggles consolidated the large region now known as Balochistan, a province rich in mineral resources. When the subcontinent began to break up, the question was asked: where did they want to go?

The Baloch voted for neither India nor Pakistan – we wanted to be “independent like Nepal” (page 115). But for some time, Balochistan was ruled by princes there, whom the Pakistani government, which sent troops and forced them to sign an agreement with Mir Ahmad Yar Khan, the prince of Kalat, to renounce Balochistan’s claim to independence.

Fatima also mentions the context of a conversation she had with Khair Bux Mari, a Baloch leader from Pakistan’s Baloch province, to complete the prose of the book. Khair Bux, representing the Baloch spirit of independence, said, ‘Very few countries are independent. But Pakistan is still a colony of the British and American imperialists. How can there be an independent view of the colony?’

Geopolitics of that time

In the 1950s, Pakistan, like many other nations, was mired in the quagmire of the Cold War. Even then, the military junta that ruled Pakistan’s politics did not consider neutrality or non-alignment an option. On 7 October 1958, General Ayub Khan seized power from President Iskander Mirza in a “surprise coup”. The illegitimate seizure of power came at a time of great chaos and political uncertainty within Pakistan, leading most Pakistanis to resent the general’s takeover.

At the age of 30, Zulfikar Bhutto joined the then government as Minister of Fuel, Energy and Natural Resources. In 1960, Zulfikar was entrusted with the sensitive task of negotiating an oil deal with the Soviet Union. Zulfikar’s visit resulted in a loan of 120 million rubles to fund further oil exploration within Pakistan, and a promise from the Soviet Union to supply experienced experts and equipment for the program.

Meanwhile, Pakistan’s relations with the Soviet Union were slowly becoming difficult due to the Pakistani regime’s insistence on siding with the United States. As it was, Pakistan’s military dictators tended to embrace any power that promised to protect them. The then Pakistani military also saw the United States as the most enabling force for its militarism.

Already effectively modernizing its military, Pakistan signed a Mutual Defense Agreement with the United States in 1954. As part of the agreement, Pakistan was encouraged to join the Southeast Asian Treaty Organization in September 1954 and later the Central Treaty Organization in 1955. Although bilateral relations were the focus of Zulfikar’s foreign policy, there was no easy way to ignore the fact that relations between Pakistan and China had seriously deteriorated under General Ayub.

The general was constantly pushing China out to make room for the US, and against China’s wishes, relations with the US took a sharp turn in 1963, when Zulfiqar, seen as the architect of Pakistan’s bilateral foreign policy, took over as foreign minister. In 1962, anticipating Pakistan’s potential relationship with China and the young foreign minister’s socialist leanings, the US transferred Rs 300 million from the State Bank of Pakistan to a counterpart fund to begin extending credit to US commercial banks operating inside Pakistan, which was seen as a clear warning to Pakistan.

The forces that see Bangladesh through the eyes of East Pakistan are not only in present-day Pakistan but also the foreign friends of the Field Marshal. The main opposition party to the Awami League is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party, whose historical roots are in deep alliances with the Islamist party Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami and whose roots have been in Pakistan since 1971.

Zulfikar’s Radical Thought vs. Zia’s Junta

Zulfikar was facing setbacks towards the end of his political reign. Henry Kissinger, who publicly described Zulfikar as a capable and intelligent politician, gave him a major reprimand for advancing Pakistan’s nuclear ambitions. Zulfikar amended the 1973 constitution several times, allowing the federal government to ban political parties.

He curbed the power of the judiciary. In an effort to secure his political position, Zulfikar amended the constitution to define the criteria for ‘who is a Muslim?’ and made peace with the small but powerful religious parties out of fear. He banned alcohol and drove the entertainment industry underground.

He declared Friday prayers a public holiday. In 1974, Zulfikar organized the second summit of Islamic countries, which Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, alias Shah-of-Iran, was not ready to attend, and Idi Amin arrived uninvited.

While declaring the success of the summit, which was attended by 38 Islamic countries, Zulfikar had said, ‘We Pakistan will give our blood for Islam.’ Pakistan will not let any Islamic country in the world feel a lack of support. However, nothing like that happened. When the US attacked Pakistan’s neighbors Iran and Afghanistan, Pakistan humbly opened its skies. Fatima says – If Zulfikar were alive, he would have felt disgusted by Pakistan’s move.

In 1976, when General Tikka Khan, known as the “Butcher of Bengal”, was retiring from the army, Zulfikar replaced him with Zia-ul-Haq, bypassing the five senior generals. Zulfikar considered Zia to be his subordinate, although Zia was cunning, ambitious and cruel.

General Zia began to develop the judiciary in favor of the junta (a military or political group that rules a country after seizing power by force).

After widespread political unrest and allegations of electoral fraud following the 1977 general elections, General Zia led a military coup and overthrew the democratically elected government of Bhutto.

By 1979, judges who showed a lack of enthusiasm for the military in the government were quickly dismissed and replaced.

Sharia courts and military tribunals were created to enforce the regime’s orders, along with the curtailment of the powers of civilian courts. Zia’s rule was not only extremely brutal, it introduced the practice of public flogging and hanging, and made the five-time daily prayer mandatory in all offices, business places, and schools in Pakistan.

Despite national and international appeals for clemency, the Supreme Court upheld the death sentence in 1979. When Zulfiqar was sentenced to death, a demonstration against the newly introduced party-less Panchayat system in Nepal turned into a large rally, with students marching towards the Pakistani embassy in Kathmandu. Zulfiqar’s hanging is often cited as a political event in the history of Nepal’s referendums.

Allah, Army, and Adalat

Without addressing the political appetites of the Pakistani Army, no understanding of Pakistan and its politics would be complete. A popular narrative about Pakistan is— the army rules the country and seizes control of the courts in the name of Allah. Last year, the 27th Amendment to the Pakistani constitution brought in some serious changes, granting expanded powers to the Pakistani Army and its top leadership, especially the army chief.

Pakistan is a country that can still be seen engaged in a ‘wrestling of selfishness’, whether it is used or abused by the superpowers. Even though Pakistan’s Prime Minister is Shahbaz Sharif, the reins of power have been under the control of the Pakistani Army.

Shahbaz Sharif, the “de jure Prime Minister,” appears to be compelled to behave in accordance with the Pakistan Army’s strategic roadmap. Can the Pakistani elite— have suffered the anguish of Pakistan’s disintegration, stop the Baloch independence movement? Can it alleviate the severe annoyances that the people of PoK and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa are expressing?

Ultimately, it appears from reading Fatima’s book that the melodies of blood and sword are once again resonating with Pakistan’s current internal turmoil!
translated:
बलूचिस्तान, खैबर पख्तूनख्वा, आरू पाकिस्तान प्रशासित कश्मीर (पीएके) मँ भयंकर तनाव के वजह स॑ गृहयुद्ध जैसनऽ स्थिति पैदा होय गेलऽ छै, हालांकि पाकिस्तान म॑ औपचारिक रूप स॑ गृहयुद्ध के घोषणा नै करलऽ गेलऽ छै । पाकिस्तान केरऽ दक्षिण-पश्चिमी प्रांत दशकऽ स॑ टकराव म॑ छै, आरू कथित तौर प॑ ‘बलूचिस्तान गणराज्य’ के नाम प॑ जारी एगो दस्तावेज न॑ नया चर्चा के प्रेरणा देल॑ छै ।

खबर छै कि पचासी प्रतिशत क्षेत्र बलूच के अधिकार में छै जे अपनऽ आजादी के घोषणा करी चुकलऽ छै । एकरऽ बावजूद कथित स्वतंत्रता पत्र म॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ दावा के अखनी तलक स्वतंत्र रूप स॑ पुष्टि नै होय सकलऽ छै । 2003 स॑ बलूचिस्तान म॑ लगातार अशांति आरू अलगाववादी आन्दोलन जारी छै, जे आजादी आरू स्वायत्तता के मांग स॑ संचालित छै । बलूच लोकक एकटा अलग भाषा आ संस्कृति अछि । पाकिस्तान केरऽ पंजाबी बहुल राजनीतिक आरू सैन्य संस्थापन द्वारा हुनका उपेक्षित महसूस होय छै ।

फातिमा भुट्टो केरऽ पुस्तक ‘रक्त आरू तलवार के गीत’ म॑ बलूच लोगऽ के नेपाल जैसनऽ अलग राष्ट्र के रूप म॑ पाकिस्तान आरू बलूचिस्तान स॑ आजादी के खोज के मनमोहक ऐतिहासिक कथ्य प्रस्तुत करलऽ गेलऽ छै । ई पुस्तक मुख्य रूप स॑ भूट्टो केरऽ महाकाव्य कहानी प॑ आधारित छै, जे नवगठित पाकिस्तान राज्य म॑ प्रमुखता हासिल करै वाला धनी सामंती जमींदारऽ के परिवार छेकै, जेकरा खून आरू तलवार के गीत म॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

ई एकटा परिवार के चारि पीढ़ी के कहानी छै आरू राजनीतिक हिंसा के कहानी छै जे अंततः ओकरऽ जान लेतै । जे कियो अनुभव केने छथि हुनका लिखल ई हत्या, भ्रष्टाचार, षड्यंत्र, आ बंटवारा सँ फाटल परिवार आ देशक कथा अछि ।

2010 म॑ प्रकाशित ई 470 पन्ना केरऽ ई पुस्तक इतिहास केरऽ समकालीन परिप्रेक्ष्य प्रदान करै छै आरू एकरऽ प्रभाव पाकिस्तान म॑ सेना केरऽ राजनीतिक महत्वाकांक्षा प॑ केना पड़ै छै । कुल मिला क॑ ई पुस्तक पाकिस्तान केरऽ भविष्य केरऽ स्थिति आरू कोर्स क॑ समझै लेली उपयोगी छै ।

नेपाल सन निर्दलीय

पाकिस्तान केरऽ बलूचिस्तान प्रांत प॑ काफी असर पड़लऽ छै । केकरा स पूछब ताहि पर बलूच लोक जे अपन गठन आ समूहीकरण मे आदिवासी छथि, हुनका सेमिटिक या ईरानी मूल के दावा कयल जाइत अछि | बलूची या अन्य क्षेत्रीय भाषा म॑ स॑ कोय भाषा बोलै वाला लोगऽ के कहना छै कि वू लोगऽ न॑ पहिलऽ सहस्राब्दी म॑ कहियो सीरिया म॑ चरवाहा के रूप म॑ अपनऽ जीवन छोड़ी क॑ बलूच प्रांत म॑ बसै स॑ पहल॑ पूरा मध्य एशिया म॑ खानाबदोश रूप स॑ यात्रा करलकै, जबकि जे लोग सीमा पार के आर्य के साथ भाषाई रूप स॑ पहचान करै छै, वू फारसी वंश के दावा करै छै ।

“डी जूर प्रधानमंत्री” शाहबाज शरीफ पाकिस्तान सेना केरऽ रणनीतिक रोडमैप के अनुसार व्यवहार करै लेली मजबूर नजर आबी रहलऽ छै । की पाकिस्तानी अभिजात वर्ग— पाकिस्तान केरऽ विघटन केरऽ पीड़ा भोगी चुकलऽ छै, बलूच स्वतंत्रता आन्दोलन क॑ रोकी सकै छै ? की ई पोक आ खैबर पख्तूनख्वा के लोक जे गंभीर परेशानी व्यक्त क रहल छथिन्ह ओकरा कम क सकैत अछि?

फातिमा भुट्टो, अपनऽ पुस्तक म॑ पाकिस्तान केरऽ अधीन बलूच केरऽ चर्चा के संदर्भ म॑ ‘नेपाल’ केरऽ स्वतंत्र दर्जा के चर्चा करल॑ छै । दशकों स बलूचिस्तानी पाकिस्तान स आजादी क लड़ाई लड़ि रहल अछि, आइयो। ब्रिटिश राज के दौरान बलूचिस्तान मुगल, फारसी आरू अफगान राज्य के हिस्सा छेलै आरू सांस्कृतिक, भाषाई आरू जातीय रूप स॑ ओकरऽ आबादी के साथ एकीकृत छेलै ।

उन्नीसवीं सदी तक ओतय के चारि रियासत में स अधिकांश राज्य ब्रिटिश राज के शासन में आनल गेल छल | युद्ध आरू साम्राज्यवादी संघर्ष न॑ ई बड़ऽ क्षेत्र क॑ मजबूत करी देलकै जेकरा अखनी बलूचिस्तान के नाम स॑ जानलऽ जाय छै, जे खनिज संसाधन स॑ भरपूर प्रांत छेकै । जखन उपमहाद्वीप टूटय लागल त सवाल पूछल गेल जे ओ सब कतय जाय चाहैत छल?

बलूच ने भारत के वोट देलक आ ने पाकिस्तान के – हम सब “नेपाल जकाँ स्वतंत्र” बनय चाहैत छलहुं (पृष्ठ 115)। लेकिन कुछ समय तलक बलूचिस्तान प॑ वहाँ के राजकुमारऽ के शासन छेलै, जेकरा प॑ पाकिस्तानी सरकार न॑ सैनिक भेजलकै आरू ओकरा सब क॑ कलात केरऽ राजकुमार मीर अहमद यार खान के साथ बलूचिस्तान केरऽ आजादी के दावा के त्याग करै लेली समझौता करै लेली मजबूर करी देलकै ।

फातिमा न॑ ई पुस्तक केरऽ गद्य क॑ पूरा करै लेली पाकिस्तान केरऽ बलूच प्रांत केरऽ बलूच नेता खैर बक्स मारी स॑ करलऽ गेलऽ बातचीत के संदर्भ के भी जिक्र करै छै । आजादी केरऽ बलूच भावना के प्रतिनिधित्व करतें खैर बक्स न॑ कहलकै कि ‘बहुत कम देश स्वतंत्र छै । मुदा पाकिस्तान एखनो ब्रिटिश आ अमेरिकी साम्राज्यवादीक उपनिवेश अछि । उपनिवेशक स्वतंत्र दृष्टिकोण कोना भ’ सकैत अछि?’

तत्कालीन भूराजनीति

1950 के दशक में पाकिस्तान भी बहुत सारा अन्य राष्ट्र के तरह शीत युद्ध के दलदल में डूबी गेलऽ छेलै । तखनो पाकिस्तान केरऽ राजनीति प॑ राज करै वाला सैन्य जुंटा तटस्थता या गैर-गठबंधन क॑ विकल्प नै मानलकै । ७ अक्टूबर १९५८ क॑ जनरल अयूब खान न॑ राष्ट्रपति इस्कंदर मिर्जा स॑ “आश्चर्यजनक तख्तापलट” करी क॑ सत्ता हथिया लेलकै । सत्ता पर नाजायज कब्जा पाकिस्तान के भीतर बहुत अराजकता आरू राजनीतिक अनिश्चितता के समय म॑ आबी गेलऽ छेलै, जेकरा चलतें अधिकांश पाकिस्तानी जनरल केरऽ अधिग्रहण स॑ नाराजगी जतैलकै ।

30 वर्षक उम्र मे जुल्फीकर भुट्टो तत्कालीन सरकार मे ईंधन, ऊर्जा आ प्राकृतिक संसाधन मंत्रीक रूप मे शामिल भ गेलाह। 1960 म॑ जुल्फीकर क॑ सोवियत संघ के साथ तेल सौदा करै के संवेदनशील काम सौंपलऽ गेलै । जुल्फीकर केरऽ ई यात्रा के परिणामस्वरूप पाकिस्तान के भीतर तेल केरऽ आरू खोज लेली फंडिंग लेली १२ करोड़ रूबल के ऋण मिललै, आरू सोवियत संघ स॑ ई कार्यक्रम लेली अनुभवी विशेषज्ञ आरू उपकरण के आपूर्ति के वादा करलऽ गेलै ।

एम्हर पाकिस्तानी शासन केरऽ अमेरिका के पक्ष लेबै के जिद के कारण सोवियत संघ के साथ पाकिस्तान केरऽ संबंध धीरे-धीरे मुश्किल होय रहलऽ छेलै । जेना कि छल, पाकिस्तान के सैन्य तानाशाह कोनो एहन शक्ति के अपनाबय के प्रवृत्ति रखैत छलाह जे हुनका सुरक्षा के वादा करय. तत्कालीन पाकिस्तानी सेना भी अमेरिका क॑ अपनऽ सैन्यवाद लेली सबसें सक्षम बनाबै वाला ताकत के रूप म॑ देखै छेलै ।

पहिने स॑ ही अपनऽ सेना क॑ प्रभावी ढंग स॑ आधुनिक बनाबै वाला पाकिस्तान न॑ १९५४ म॑ अमेरिका के साथ आपसी रक्षा समझौता प॑ हस्ताक्षर करलकै ।ई समझौता के हिस्सा के तौर प॑ पाकिस्तान क॑ सितंबर १९५४ म॑ दक्षिण पूर्व एशियाई संधि संगठन आरू बाद म॑ १९५५ म॑ केंद्रीय संधि संगठन म॑ शामिल होय लेली प्रोत्साहित करलऽ गेलै ।हालांकि द्विपक्षीय संबंध जुल्फीकर केरऽ विदेश नीति केरऽ केंद्र बिंदु छेलै, लेकिन एकरा नजरअंदाज करै के कोय आसान तरीका नै छेलै ई तथ्य कि जनरल अयूब केरऽ समय म॑ पाकिस्तान आरू चीन के बीच संबंध गंभीर रूप स॑ खराब होय गेलऽ छेलै ।

जनरल चीन क॑ लगातार अमेरिका लेली जगह बनाबै लेली बाहर धकेल॑ रहलऽ छेलै आरू चीन केरऽ इच्छा के खिलाफ १९६३ म॑ अमेरिका के साथ संबंध म॑ तेज मोड़ आबी गेलै, जब॑ पाकिस्तान केरऽ द्विपक्षीय विदेश नीति केरऽ शिल्पकार के रूप म॑ देखलऽ जाय वाला जुल्फिकार न॑ विदेश मंत्री के पद संभाली लेलकै । 1962 म॑ चीन के साथ पाकिस्तान केरऽ संभावित संबंध आरू युवा विदेश मंत्री केरऽ समाजवादी झुकाव के पूर्वानुमान लगाबैत॑ हुअ॑ अमेरिका न॑ पाकिस्तान केरऽ स्टेट बैंक स॑ 30 करोड़ रुपया क॑ एक समकक्ष कोष म॑ हस्तांतरित करी क॑ पाकिस्तान के भीतर संचालित अमेरिकी वाणिज्यिक बैंकऽ क॑ ऋण देना शुरू करी देलकै, जेकरा पाकिस्तान लेली एगो स्पष्ट चेतावनी के रूप म॑ देखलऽ गेलै ।

पूर्वी पाकिस्तान के नजर स॑ बंगलादेश क॑ देखै वाला ताकत खाली वर्तमान पाकिस्तान म॑ ही नै छै बल्कि फील्ड मार्शल केरऽ विदेशी दोस्त भी छै । अवामी लीग केरऽ मुख्य विपक्षी दल बांग्लादेश राष्ट्रवादी पार्टी छेकै, जेकरऽ ऐतिहासिक जड़ इस्लामिक पार्टी बांग्लादेश जमात-ए-इस्लामी के साथ गहरा गठबंधन म॑ छै आरू जेकरऽ जड़ १९७१ स॑ पाकिस्तान म॑ छै ।

जुल्फिकर के कट्टरपंथी विचार बनाम जिया के जुंटा |

जुल्फीकर क॑ अपनऽ राजनीतिक शासन के अंत के तरफ असफलता के सामना करना पड़॑ लगलऽ छेलै । हेनरी किसिंजर, जे सार्वजनिक रूप स॑ जुल्फिकर क॑ एगो सक्षम आरू बुद्धिमान राजनीतिज्ञ बतैलकै, न॑ पाकिस्तान केरऽ परमाणु महत्वाकांक्षा क॑ आगू बढ़ाबै लेली हुनका एगो बड़ऽ डांट देलकै । जुल्फीकर 1973 के संविधान में कई बेर संशोधन केलक, जाहि में संघीय सरकार राजनीतिक दल पर रोक लगाबय के अनुमति देलक।

न्यायपालिकाक सत्ता पर लगाम लगा देलनि। अपनऽ राजनीतिक स्थिति सुरक्षित करै के कोशिश म॑ जुल्फीकर न॑ संविधान म॑ संशोधन करी क॑ ‘मुसलमान के छै?’ के मापदंड परिभाषित करलकै आरू डर स॑ छोटऽ लेकिन शक्तिशाली धार्मिक दलऽ स॑ शांति करलकै । ओ शराब पर रोक लगा देलनि आ मनोरंजन उद्योग के भूमिगत भगा देलखिन्ह.

शुक्रवार के नमाज के सार्वजनिक छुट्टी घोषित क देलखिन। १९७४ म॑ जुल्फीकर न॑ इस्लामी देशऽ के दोसरऽ शिखर सम्मेलन के आयोजन करलकै, जेकरा म॑ मोहम्मद रेजा पहलवी उर्फ ​​ईरान केरऽ शाह, भाग लेबै लेली तैयार नै छेलै, आरू इदी अमीन बिना आमंत्रित के पहुँची गेलै ।

३८ इस्लामिक देशऽ न॑ भाग लेन॑ वाला ई शिखर सम्मेलन के सफलता के घोषणा करतें हुअ॑ जुल्फीकर न॑ कहलकै कि ‘हम पाकिस्तान इस्लाम लेली अपनऽ खून देबै ।’ पाकिस्तान दुनिया केरऽ कोय भी इस्लामी देश क॑ समर्थन के कमी नै महसूस करै देतै । ओना एहन किछु नहि भेल। जखन अमेरिका पाकिस्तान के पड़ोसी देश ईरान आ अफगानिस्तान पर हमला केलक त पाकिस्तान विनम्रता सं अपन आसमान खोललक. फातिमा कहैत छथि – जँ जुल्फीकर जीवित रहितथि त’ पाकिस्तानक एहि कदम सँ हुनका घृणा होइतनि ।

1976 मे जखन जनरल टिक्का खान जे “बंगाल क कसाई” क नाम स जानल जाइत छलाह तखन सेना स रिटायर भ रहल छलाह त जुल्फीकर हुनकर जगह जिया उल हक कए पांचटा वरिष्ठ जनरल कए बाईपास करि देलथि । जुल्फीकर जिया के अपनऽ अधीनस्थ मानलकै, हालांकि जिया धूर्त, महत्वाकांक्षी आरू क्रूर छेलै ।

जनरल जिया न्यायपालिका के विकास जुंटा (एक सैन्य या राजनीतिक समूह जे जबरदस्ती सत्ता पर कब्जा करला के बाद कोनो देश पर शासन करै छै) के पक्ष में करै लगलै ।

१९७७ केरऽ आम चुनाव के बाद व्यापक राजनीतिक अशांति आरू चुनावी धोखाधड़ी के आरोप के बाद जनरल जिया न॑ सैन्य तख्तापलट के नेतृत्व करी क॑ लोकतांत्रिक तरीका स॑ चुनलऽ भुट्टो सरकार क॑ उखाड़ फेंकलकै ।

1979 तक सरकार मे सेना क प्रति उत्साह क कमी देखनिहार जज कए जल्दीए बर्खास्त क देल गेल आ हुनकर जगह पर राखल गेल।

शासन केरऽ आदेश क॑ लागू करै लेली शरीयत कोर्ट आरू सैन्य ट्रिब्यूनल के निर्माण करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै, साथ ही सिविल कोर्ट केरऽ अधिकार म॑ कटौती भी करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । जिया केरऽ शासन न सिर्फ अत्यंत क्रूर छेलै, बल्कि सार्वजनिक रूप स॑ कोड़ा मारना आरू फांसी केरऽ प्रथा शुरू करी देलकै, आरू पाकिस्तान केरऽ सब कार्यालय, व्यापारिक जगह, आरू स्कूल म॑ रोजाना पांच बार नमाज पढ़ना अनिवार्य करी देलकै ।

दया केरऽ राष्ट्रीय आरू अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अपील के बावजूद सुप्रीम कोर्ट न॑ १९७९ म॑ फांसी के सजा क॑ बरकरार रखलकै । जुल्फिकर क॑ जब॑ फाँसी के सजा सुनवाय देलऽ गेलै त॑ नेपाल म॑ नवका शुरू करलऽ गेलऽ पार्टी-रहित पंचायत प्रणाली के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन एगो बड़ऽ रैली म॑ बदली गेलै, जेकरा म॑ छात्रऽ न॑ काठमांडू म॑ पाकिस्तानी दूतावास के तरफ मार्च करलकै । जुल्फिकार केरऽ फांसी क॑ अक्सर नेपाल केरऽ जनमत संग्रह के इतिहास म॑ एगो राजनीतिक घटना के रूप म॑ उद्धृत करलऽ जाय छै ।

अल्लाह, सेना, आ अदालत

पाकिस्तानी सेना केरऽ राजनीतिक भूख क॑ संबोधित करला के बिना पाकिस्तान आरू ओकरऽ राजनीति केरऽ कोय भी समझ पूरा नै होतै । पाकिस्तान के बारे में एगो लोकप्रिय कथ्य छै— सेना देश पर राज करै छै आरू अल्लाह के नाम पर कोर्टऽ पर नियंत्रण कब्जा करी लै छै । पिछला साल पाकिस्तानी संविधान मँ 27वां संशोधन मँ कुछ गंभीर बदलाव आबी गेलै, जेकरा मँ पाकिस्तानी सेना आरू ओकरौ शीर्ष नेतृत्व खास करी क सेना प्रमुख क विस्तारित अधिकार मिललै ।

पाकिस्तान एगो ऐसनऽ देश छै जेकरा अखनी भी ‘स्वार्थ केरऽ कुश्ती’ म॑ जुटलऽ देखलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै, चाहे ओकरऽ उपयोग महाशक्ति सिनी द्वारा करलऽ जाय या दुरुपयोग करलऽ जाय । पाकिस्तान केरऽ प्रधानमंत्री शाहबाज शरीफ भले ही सत्ता केरऽ बागडोर पाकिस्तानी सेना के नियंत्रण म॑ रहलऽ छै ।

“डी जूर प्रधानमंत्री” शाहबाज शरीफ पाकिस्तान सेना केरऽ रणनीतिक रोडमैप के अनुसार व्यवहार करै लेली मजबूर नजर आबी रहलऽ छै । की पाकिस्तानी अभिजात वर्ग— पाकिस्तान केरऽ विघटन केरऽ पीड़ा भोगी चुकलऽ छै, बलूच स्वतंत्रता आन्दोलन क॑ रोकी सकै छै ? की ई पोक आ खैबर पख्तूनख्वा के लोक जे गंभीर परेशानी व्यक्त क रहल छथिन्ह ओकरा कम क सकैत अछि?

अंततः फातिमा केरऽ किताब पढ़ला स॑ पता चलै छै कि खून आरू तलवार केरऽ धुन एक बार फेरू पाकिस्तान केरऽ वर्तमान आंतरिक उथल-पुथल के साथ गुंजायमान होय ​​रहलऽ छै !

title: Nepal's biggest export to India: Instagram reels - Nepali Times
description: Nepal's biggest export to India: Instagram reels  Nepali Times
publisher.title: Nepali Times
full_article:
A clip from Kathmandu, September 2025. A young man plants himself in front of a police water cannon, letting the water jet smash into him. Ten months later the same frame is circulating in Indian feeds as fan art, recoloured and captioned: Let's go Indian GenZ.

However many in India, including the Cockroach Janta Party, have tried to say that what happened there this month is fundamentally different from Nepal, Bangladesh or Sri Lanka, there are parallels. Especially in the world of memes.

Several genres of reels have gone across the border. In one, an Indian creator walks through Kathmandu praising the civic sense of Nepalis as evidence about his own country’s failures.

In another, a Nepali creator films an Indian tourist cooking on a Pokhara footpath and holds him up as evidence for Indian tourists polluting Nepal.

The same message is coming from opposite directions. Both do the same work — for a certain kind of Indian content creator tourist visiting Pokhara, Nepal is not just a neighbour but a reference image in the feed.

Seventy-six Nepalis died in September 2025. In Delhi's CJP protests there were batons, tear gas, detentions and a 26-day hunger strike, but no one was killed although dozens of earlier suicides were blamed on leaked NEET exam papers.

What interests me is the trade route. Nepal's actual exports to India move through Birganj. They queue at customs, get weighed, pay, and wait. But an Instagram reel crosses in a fraction of a second, pays no duty, needs no transit agreement, and clears Raxaul without anyone at the border knowing it happened.

The only party taking a cut is the Dalal - Meta™. And Meta Sahib takes it in attention rather than rupees. This is the most efficient smuggler on the virtual border between India and Nepal, and the products are memes and meme formats.

During the September protests I made a meme setting the 'who was interested in each other first?' TikTok sound, normally a couples' bit, against a line of riot police. It did about 2 million views. The same sound turned up on Indian feeds this summer, pointed at the same target.

I made one of these, so I know exactly how little effort it takes and how far it goes. The Subway Surfers chase edit crossed too. So did the water cannon. Memes are meant to be shared, remixed, and redistributed. Yet what memes are redistributed, remixed or shared tells us more than the likes, comments or shares.

SUMMONS AND DRILLS

In Nepal, the memes were about showing up, and most of them were made after showing up. The aura shot in front of the water cannon. The silhouette against the burning building. What spread hardest was footage of arrival, of bodies present where they were not supposed to be. Our meme was a summons.

Jantar Mantar in Delhi had a lot of them too. But there was a second layer. Indian memes were also about dodging: how to take a water cannon, finding loopholes so that the police do not beat you. One meme was cut like a film scene, captioned: ‘Me at the protest saving a 10/10 baddie from the water cannon’, showing a hero pulling the heroine clear of the water cannon, saving her from the state’s violence.

That is what watching a neighbour gets you. India's youth did not only replicate our memes, they studied our footage and worked out what a protest against the government actually requires.

COSTUME AND INSIGNIA

Jantar Mantar had Superman, Spider-Man and at least one T-Rex. It had a man dressed as Mahatma Gandhi captioned 'wild card entry', on the joke that things had got bad enough for Gandhi to come back from the dead and protest. That post got 600,000 likes. People carried printed memes as placards.

Kathmandu had the skull-and-bones and straw hat. Straw hats turned up at Jantar Mantar, but as guests. They were not the host language. The costumed appearances were individual bits, each its own post, each competing with the others.

AURA ECONOMY

There is a name for this: aura farming. It works for the movement, in the crudest possible way. An outrageous costume at the protest trends. Trending brings traction. Traction brings the next crowd. The joke is load-bearing.

Look at what it costs, though. The T-Rex flattens the thing it is standing inside. What happened at Jantar Mantar was a generation revolting against a system that has failed it for years and buried some of its peers. In costume, it is photographed as a festival. And people who arrive having seen a festival come to film one.

I think it’s important to understand that we underestimate how badly the young want to go viral. Ask any gen-alpha kid what they want to be when they grow up - they will most likely say vlogger, youtuber, or gamer. This week three Nepali tots walking from school in colourful raincoats were filmed on TikTok, went viral, and they were handed scholarships.

Virality is no longer only social capital. It is a working economic instrument, and for a lot of young people it is the only one available without connections.

That pull gets people to dance in front of a camera. It gets them to say outrageous things on livecam. It is not why anyone marched on Sansad Marg last month or in Baneswor last year. But it was somewhere in the mix, which tells you something about my generation worth sitting with.

IDENTITY SLOT

When the Chief Justice of India called unemployed young people cockroaches and parasites, the next morning there was a graphic reading Main Bhi Cockroach, and within four days the account carrying it had more followers than the BJP.

India is not short of identities on offer. Religion, caste, class, region, language, are all older than the republic and all contested. The cockroach is keyed to none of them. To claim it you need nothing except to be online. Put the emoji in your bio and you are in.

Note the direction, though. Our defining insult pointed up. Nepo kid was the youth naming the elite. In India, it came down from the Chief Justice, the elite naming the youth as vermin, and it was caught in mid-air and worn. What a catch.

ENDINGS DIFFER

None of this explains why one movement took a government and the other only took a minister.

Leaderlessness does. A movement with nobody at its head cannot be negotiated with. It can only be survived or fled from, and K P Oli fled. India’s Cockroaches had a founder who is a professional communications strategist, a manifesto, named spokespersons. On 24 July they sat down with two union ministers. On the 25th Dharmendra Pradhan resigned. That evening they went home.

State capacity matters a lot. Nepal also banned 26 platforms before the protest, India withheld one account and got a replacement titled Cockroach Is Back, with a bio saying ‘cockroaches do not die’.

Delhi had watched Dhaka in 2024 and Kathmandu in 2025 and drawn the obvious conclusion that a ‘GenZ’ movement handled badly does not stay a student movement. Its police were trained for a job ours had never expected to do.

Photo: WIKIMEDIA COMMONS

SCAPEGOAT

René Girard argued that a community in crisis resolves it by converging on a single victim. Expel him and peace returns, while whatever caused the crisis stays exactly where it was.

We do this constantly. A rural road washes out in the first monsoon after it is blacktopped. The district engineer is suspended, his name runs in the papers, the anger has somewhere to go. The contractor who has won that tender for a decade bids again in the autumn. Nobody suspends the procurement process. That is the scapegoat, to redirect people’s anger towards a person instead of a system.

A memetic movement is unusually good at producing a mimetic scapegoat, because both run on imitation. A meme is imitation that spreads. A scapegoat is imitation that converges. The format wants one face in the frame.

You could meme the National Testing Agency, but you cannot scapegoat it. It is too abstract a structure. You can meme a minister, and you can scapegoat him. Done and dusted. Guyz, the education minister resigned, all problems fixed! Not.

Pradhan is gone. The leak that made 2.2 million Indian students sit the same exam twice is not addressed by his absence. Neither is the education policy, nor the revolving door between the bench and the Cabinet that the CJP named in its own manifesto. The sacrifice worked and that is exactly the problem.

FROM HERE

I only know the Indian protest through what my Meta™ Dalal chose to hand me. It is possible I only saw the memes.

But I know what the week after feels like. We got our scapegoat in three days. We burned down Parliament, cremated our dead, and we elected a prime minister who is better at Facebook than anyone else in South Asia. Ten months on, the grievance that put us on the street is intact.

A resignation is a receipt, not a reform. My message to GenZ Indians: Ride the wave. Then, watch the next exam cycle instead of the next trend.
translated:
काठमांडू केरऽ एगो क्लिप, सितम्बर २०२५. दस महीना बाद इएह फ्रेम भारतीय फीड मे फैन आर्ट के रूप मे घूमि रहल अछि, जकरा फेर सं रंगल गेल अछि आ कैप्शन देल गेल अछि: चलू भारतीय जेनजेड.

कोकरोच जनता पार्टी सहित भारत मे भले बहुतो लोक ई कहबाक प्रयास केने छथि जे एहि मास ओतय जे भेल से नेपाल, बांग्लादेश या श्रीलंका सं मौलिक रूप सं अलग अछि, एकर समानांतर सेहो अछि. खास क' मीम के दुनिया मे।

रील के कई विधा सीमा पार चलि गेल अछि। एकटा मे एकटा भारतीय रचनाकार नेपालीक नागरिक भावना केँ अपनहि देशक असफलताक प्रमाणक रूप मे प्रशंसा करैत काठमांडू मे घुमैत छथि ।

दोसर मे एकटा नेपाली निर्माता पोखरा फुटपाथ पर खाना बनाबय वाला भारतीय पर्यटक के फिल्मांकन करैत भारतीय पर्यटक के नेपाल के प्रदूषित करय के सबूत के रूप मे ऊपर उठबैत छथि.

विपरीत दिशा स इएह संदेश आबि रहल अछि। दुनू एकहि काज करैत छथि — पोखरा घुमैत एकटा खास तरहक भारतीय सामग्री निर्माता पर्यटक लेल नेपाल मात्र पड़ोसी नहि अपितु फीड मे संदर्भ छवि अछि ।

सितम्बर २०२५ मे छहत्तरि नेपालीके मृत्यु भेल छल ।दिल्लीक भाकपा विरोधमे लाठी, आंसू गैस, हिरासत आ २६ दिनक अनशन भेल छल, मुदा पहिने दर्जनों आत्महत्याक दोष नीट परीक्षा पत्र लीक भेलाक कारणेँ ककरो मृत्यु नहि भेल छल ।

हमरा जे रुचि अछि ओ अछि व्यापारिक मार्ग। भारत मे नेपालक वास्तविक निर्यात वीरगंज होइत चलि जाइत अछि । कस्टम मे कतार मे लागि जाइत छथि, तौलैत छथि, पाइ दैत छथि, आ प्रतीक्षा करैत छथि। लेकिन एक इंस्टाग्राम रील एक सेकंड के अंश में पार होय जाय छै, कोनो ड्यूटी नै दै छै, कोनो ट्रांजिट एग्रीमेंट के जरूरत नै छै, आरू रक्सौल के खाली करी दै छै, बिना सीमा पर केकरो ई पता चलै कि ई घटित होय गेलऽ छै.

एकमात्र पार्टी जे कट लैत अछि ओ अछि दलाल - मेटाTM। आ मेटा साहब एकरा रुपैया स बेसी ध्यान मे लैत अछि। भारत आरू नेपाल के बीच आभासी सीमा पर ई सबसें कुशल तस्कर छै, आरू उत्पाद मीम आरू मीम फॉर्मेट के छै ।

सितंबर के विरोध के दौरान हम एकटा मीम बनेलहुं जे 'पहिने एक दोसरा में केकरा रुचि छल?' टिकटॉक आवाज, सामान्यतः एकटा जोड़ी के बिट, दंगा पुलिस के लाइन के खिलाफ. लगभग 20 लाख व्यूज केलक। एहि गर्मी मे भारतीय फीड पर सेहो इएह आवाज आयल, ओही निशाना दिस इशारा केलक।

हम एहि मे स एकटा बनेलहुं, ताहि लेल हमरा ठीक स पता अछि जे एहि मे कतेक कम मेहनत लगैत अछि आ कतेक दूर तक पहुंचैत अछि। सबवे सर्फर्स चेस एडिट सेहो पार भ गेल। तहिना पानिक तोप सेहो। मीम के मतलब छै कि साझा करलऽ जाय, रीमिक्स करलऽ जाय, आरू पुनः वितरित करलऽ जाय । तइयो कोन मीम के पुनर्वितरण, रीमिक्स या शेयर कयल जाइत अछि से लाइक, कमेंट या शेयर स बेसी किछु बताबैत अछि।

समन एवं अभ्यास

नेपाल मे मीम देखाबय के छल, आओर बेसी देखाबय के बाद बनल छल. पानिक तोप के सामने आभा गोली चलल। जरैत भवनक विरुद्ध सिल्हूट। सबसँ बेसी जे पसरल छल ओ छल आगमनक फुटेज, जतय नहि हेबाक चाही छल ओतय उपस्थित लाशक। हमर मीम एकटा समन छल।

दिल्ली मे जंतर मंतर मे सेहो बहुत रास छल। मुदा दोसर परत छल। भारतीय मीम सेहो चकमा देबय के छल: पानिक तोप कोना लेब, लूपहोल खोजब जाहि सं पुलिस अहां के नहिं मारि सकय. एकटा मीम फिल्मक दृश्य जकाँ काटल गेल छल, जकर कैप्शन छल: ‘मी एट द प्रोटेस्ट सेविंग ए 10/10 बैडी फ्रॉम द वाटर कैनन’, जाहि मे एकटा नायक नायिका केँ वाटर कैनन सँ साफ खींचैत देखाओल गेल छल, जाहि सँ ओकरा राज्यक हिंसा सँ बचाओल गेल छल.

पड़ोसी के देखला स इएह भेटैत अछि। भारत के युवा न सिर्फ हमरऽ मीम के नकल नै करलकै, बल्कि हमरऽ फुटेज के अध्ययन करी क॑ ई काम करलकै कि सरकार के खिलाफ विरोध करै लेली वास्तव म॑ की जरूरी छै ।

वेशभूषा एवं निशान

जंतर मंतर मे सुपरमैन, स्पाइडर मैन आ कम स कम एकटा टी-रेक्स छल। एकरा म॑ महात्मा गांधी केरऽ कपड़ा पहिनलऽ एगो आदमी न॑ ‘वाइल्ड कार्ड एंट्री’ के कैप्शन देल॑ छेलै, ई मजाक प॑ कि हालात एतना खराब होय गेलऽ छै कि गांधी मृतकऽ स॑ वापस आबी क॑ विरोध करलकै । ओहि पोस्ट के छह लाख लाइक भेटल। लोक प्लेकार्ड के रूप मे छपल मीम ल क चलैत छल।

काठमांडू मे खोपड़ी-हड्डी आ भूसाक टोपी छल। जंतर मंतर पर भूसाक टोपी आबि गेल, मुदा पाहुनक रूप मे। ओ सभ मेजबान भाषा नहि छल। वेशभूषा में उपस्थिति अलग-अलग बिट छल, प्रत्येक के अपन पोस्ट, प्रत्येक दोसर के संग प्रतिस्पर्धा करैत छल.

आभा अर्थव्यवस्था

एकर एकटा नाम अछि आभा खेती। ई आन्दोलन के लेल काज करैत अछि, कच्चा संभव तरीका स। विरोध के रुझान पर एक अपमानजनक वेशभूषा। ट्रेंडिंग कर्षण लाबैत अछि। कर्षण अगिला भीड़ ल क अबैत अछि। मजाक भार-भारी अछि।

देखू, एकर की खर्च होइत छैक, तथापि। टी-रेक्स ओहि चीज के समतल क दैत अछि जे ओ भीतर ठाढ़ अछि। जंतर मंतर मे जे भेल से एकटा एहन पीढ़ी छल जे एकटा एहन व्यवस्था क खिलाफ विद्रोह केलक जे ओकरा सालों स असफल क रहल अछि आ अपन किछु साथी कए दफना देलक। वेशभूषा मे एकर फोटो पाबनि के रूप मे लेल जाइत अछि । आ कोनो महोत्सव देखि पहुंचय वाला लोक एकटा फिल्माबय लेल अबैत छथिन्ह.

हमरा बुझने ई बुझब जरूरी अछि जे हम सब कम आंकि लैत छी जे युवा कतेक खराब तरीका स’ वायरल होबय चाहैत छथि. कोनो जेन-अल्फा बच्चा सं पूछू जे ओ पैघ भेला पर की बनय चाहैत छथि - ओ बेसी संभावना जे व्लॉगर, यूट्यूबर, या गेमर कहताह. एहि सप्ताह रंग-बिरंगक रेनकोट मे स्कूल सं चलैत तीन टा नेपाली टॉट्स के टिकटॉक पर फिल्मायल गेल, वायरल भ गेल, आओर हुनका सभ के छात्रवृत्ति देल गेल.

वायरलिटी आब मात्र सामाजिक पूंजी नहि रहि गेल अछि। ई एकटा काज करय वाला आर्थिक साधन अछि, आ बहुत रास युवा के लेल ई एकमात्र एहन साधन अछि जे बिना कनेक्शन के उपलब्ध अछि.

ओहि खींचतान सं लोक कैमरा के सामने नाचय लागय छथिन्ह. एहि सं हुनका लाइवकैम पर अपमानजनक बात कहय पड़ैत छनि. ई कियैक नहि जे पिछला मास संसाद मार्ग पर कियो मार्च केने छल आ कि पिछला साल बनसवॉर मे. मुदा ई कतहु मिक्स मे छल, जे हमर पीढ़ी के बारे मे किछु बताबैत अछि जे संग बैसय लायक अछि.

पहचान स्लॉट

भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश जखन बेरोजगार युवा सब के तिलचट्टा आ परजीवी कहलखिन त दोसर दिन भोरे एकटा ग्राफिक लिखल छल जे मैं भी तिलचट्टा छल, आ चारि दिन के भीतर एकरा ल क चलय वाला खाता के भाजपा स बेसी फॉलोअर्स भ गेल।

भारत मे ऑफर मे पहचान क कमी नहि अछि। धर्म, जाति, वर्ग, क्षेत्र, भाषा, सब गणतंत्र स पुरान अछि आ सब विवादित अछि । तिलचट्टा कोनो मे सँ कोनो मे चाभी नहि लागल अछि। एकर दावा करय लेल अहां के ऑनलाइन रहय के अलावा किछ के जरूरत नहिं. इमोजी अपन बायो में राखू आ अहाँ में छी।

दिशा पर ध्यान दियौक, तथापि। हमर परिभाषित अपमान ऊपर इशारा केलक। नेपो किड अभिजात वर्ग के नाम लेबय वाला युवा छल. भारत मे ई मुख्य न्यायाधीश सँ उतरल छल, अभिजात वर्ग युवा के कीड़ा-मकोड़ा कहैत छल, आ एकरा हवा मे पकड़ि क' पहिरल गेल छल. केहन पकड़ल गेल।

अंत अलग-अलग होइत अछि

एहि मे सँ कोनो बात ई नहि बुझा सकैत अछि जे एकटा आन्दोलन सरकार किएक लेलक आ दोसर मात्र मंत्री केँ लेलक।

नेतृत्वहीनता करैत अछि। जकर माथ पर ककरो नहि हो आन्दोलन सँ बातचीत नहि कयल जा सकैत अछि । एकरा मात्र बचल जा सकैत अछि वा भागल जा सकैत अछि, आ के पी ओली भागि गेल। भारत केरऽ तिलचट्टा केरऽ एगो संस्थापक छेलै जे एगो पेशेवर संचार रणनीतिकार छै, एगो घोषणापत्र, नामित प्रवक्ता । 24 जुलाई कए ओ दूटा केंद्रीय मंत्री क संग बैसलाह। 25 तारीख के धर्मेन्द्र प्रधान इस्तीफा द देलखिन्ह. ओहि साँझ ओ सभ घर चलि गेलाह।

राज्यक क्षमता बहुत मायने रखैत अछि। नेपाल विरोध प्रदर्शन स पहिने 26 प्लेटफॉर्म पर सेहो रोक लगा देलक, भारत एकटा खाता रोकलक आ ओकर जगह पर कोकरोच इज बैक नामक एकटा खाता भेटल, जाहि मे एकटा बायो मे लिखल छल जे ‘कोकरोच नहि मरैत अछि’।

दिल्ली न॑ २०२४ म॑ ढाका आरू २०२५ म॑ काठमांडू क॑ देखन॑ छेलै आरू ई स्पष्ट निष्कर्ष निकाललकै कि खराब तरीका स॑ संभाललऽ गेलऽ ‘जेनजेड’ आन्दोलन छात्र आन्दोलन नै रह॑ छै । एकर पुलिस एहन काज लेल प्रशिक्षित छल जेकर उम्मीद हमरा सबहक कहियो नहि छल।

फोटो: विकिमीडिया कॉमन

बलिदान के बकरा

रेने गिरार्ड केरऽ तर्क छेलै कि संकट म॑ पड़लऽ समुदाय एकरऽ समाधान एक ही पीड़ित प॑ अभिसरण करी क॑ करै छै । ओकरा भगा दियौक आ शांति वापस आबि जाइत छैक, जखन कि जे किछु संकट के कारण बनल से ठीक ओतहि रहैत छैक जतय छलैक।

हम सब निरंतर ई काज करैत छी। एकटा ग्रामीण सड़क ब्लैकटॉप के बाद पहिल मानसून में बहैत अछि. जिला अभियंता निलंबित अछि, कागज मे ओकर नाम दौड़ैत अछि, तामस के कतहु जाय के अछि। जे ठेकेदार एक दशक स ओहि टेंडर कए जीत चुकल अछि ओ शरद ऋतु मे फेर स बोली लगा दैत अछि। खरीद प्रक्रिया कए कियो निलंबित नहि करैत अछि। ओ अछि बलि के बकरा, लोकक क्रोध केँ कोनो व्यवस्थाक बदला कोनो व्यक्ति दिस पुनर्निर्देशित करब.

मेमेटिक आन्दोलन नकल बलि के बकरा के उत्पादन में असामान्य रूप स नीक होइत अछि, कारण दुनू नकल पर चलैत अछि । मीम नकल होइत अछि जे पसरैत अछि। बलि के बकरा नकल छै जे अभिसरण करै छै। प्रारूप फ्रेम मे एकटा चेहरा चाहैत अछि।

अहां नेशनल टेस्टिंग एजेंसी के मीम क सकय छी, मुदा ओकरा बलि के बकरा नहिं बना सकय छी. ई बेसी अमूर्त संरचना अछि। कोनो मंत्री के मीम क सकैत छी, आ ओकरा बलि के बकरा बना सकैत छी। कयल आ धूल-धूसरित। गाइज, शिक्षा मंत्री इस्तीफा द देलखिन, सब समस्या ठीक भ गेल! नहि।

प्रधान चलि गेलाह। 22 लाख भारतीय छात्र दू बेर एकहि परीक्षा मे बैसय वाला लीक के हुनकर अनुपस्थिति सं संबोधित नहिं कएल जा सकैत अछि. ने शिक्षा नीति अछि, आ ने पीठ आ मंत्रिमंडल के बीच घुमावदार दरवाजा जेकर नाम भाजपा अपन घोषणापत्र मे रखने छल। त्याग काज केलक आ ठीक वैह समस्या अछि।

एतय सँ

भारतीय विरोध के हम केवल ओहि माध्यम स जनैत छी जे हमर मेटाTM दलाल हमरा हाथ मे देबय लेल चुनलनि। संभव अछि जे हम मात्र मीम देखलहुं।

मुदा ओकर बादक सप्ताह केहन होइत छैक से हमरा बुझल अछि। तीन दिन मे हमरा लोकनि केँ अपन बलि-बकरी भेटि गेल। हम संसद के जरा देलियैक, अपन मृतक के अंतिम संस्कार केलहुं, आ एकटा एहन प्रधानमंत्री चुनलहुं जे दक्षिण एशिया के सब सं नीक फेसबुक पर नीक छथि. दस मास बाद जे शिकायत हमरा सब कए सड़क पर उतारलक ओ अक्षुण्ण अछि।

इस्तीफा रसीद होइत छैक, सुधार नहि। जेनजेड भारतीय के लेल हमर संदेश : लहर के सवारी करू। तखन, अगिला ट्रेंड के जगह अगिला परीक्षा चक्र देखू.

full_article:
Nepal’s prime minister, who had barely spoken in public since taking office in March, finally addressed the nation after at least three people were killed in communal violence that began in Sunsari district and later spread to the neighbouring Madhesh province. Prime Minister Balendra Shah appealed for patience, restraint and unity after people were killed in the violence, prompting authorities to extend the curfew to new areas.

A dispute over loudspeakers and religious flags during a Hindu procession in Sunsari spiralled, within days, into clashes that spread across provincial lines into Siraha and Dhanusha. This is not simply a story about Hindu-Muslim tension. It is a story about a state that keeps discovering, too late, that it has no early-warning system for its own fault lines — and that keeps responding to crises with curfews rather than efficient prevention.

STORY CONTINUES BELOW THIS AD

Nepal’s recurring incidents of communal unrest are not primarily failures of tolerance between neighbours. They are failures of governance — of a state so consumed by its own political turnover that it has neglected the machinery of local mediation, timely policing, and visible accountability that keeps small disputes from becoming national emergencies.

More from Opinion Curfew continues across Nepal after sectarian clashes kill three 'I take responsibility': Dharmendra Pradhan says 'India's youth power is the true strength' | Full text of resignation letter

The violence in Sunsari began on a Sunday night. A curfew followed on Monday. By Thursday, the unrest had jumped provinces, and only then did the prime minister speak. Four days is not a long time, but it is an eternity in a fast-moving communal dispute, where each hour of official silence matters. Governments that respond quickly to flashpoints rarely see them metastasise into multi-district emergencies. Governments that respond only once the toll has risen invite the perception that violence is what finally earns attention.

President Ramchandra Poudel spoke out before the Prime Minister’s address to the nation. Opposition lawmakers, including members of the Nepali Congress, raised the alarm in Parliament while the government remained quiet. A functioning state does not outsource its crisis leadership to the ceremonial presidency and the opposition benches.

There is also the question of the police firing that killed the first victim in Sunsari. The government has promised an investigation and pledged that it will be transparent. Promises of transparency are the cheapest currency in politics precisely because they cost nothing to make and everything to keep. Nepal’s recent history — mass protests less than a year ago that toppled a government and killed dozens — was itself fuelled by public disbelief that official investigations would ever produce real consequences. If this inquiry follows the same trajectory of announcement, delay, and quiet burial, it will not restore trust; it will confirm the cynicism that made this week’s unrest so combustible in the first place.

STORY CONTINUES BELOW THIS AD

Nepal does not lack goodwill among its citizens. What it lacks is a state apparatus that treats early tremors as seriously as it treats the aftermath. Curfews restore order the way a tourniquet stops bleeding: necessary, but no substitute for treating the wound. Balendra Shah has now made his appeal. The harder test will be whether the investigation he promised either produces names and consequences or joins the long shelf of Nepali inquiries that end in silence.

The smoke will clear from those market towns soon enough. The question is whether anything is actually rebuilt in its place — or whether Nepal is simply waiting, again, for the next spark.

title: Nepal and China Celebrate 71 Years of Diplomatic Relations - Ratopati
description: Nepal and China Celebrate 71 Years of Diplomatic Relations  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. 71 years have been completed today since the establishment of diplomatic relations between Nepal and China. On this occasion, China's Ambassador to Nepal, Zhang Mao Ming, has expressed his commitment to further strengthen the traditional friendship, mutual respect, and cooperation based on mutual benefit between the two countries.

In the congratulatory message issued by Ambassador Zhang, it is mentioned that on the occasion of the 71st anniversary of the establishment of China-Nepal diplomatic relations, the sustainable friendship, mutual respect, and cooperation based on mutual benefit between the two countries have been continuously strengthening for the past 71 years.

In the message, he stated that he is eager to cooperate with Nepal to further elevate the strategic partnership based on lasting friendship for development and prosperity by continuously advancing the traditional friendship with Nepal, and thereby bringing more benefits to the people of both countries.

Diplomatic relations between Nepal and China were established on August 1, 1955. Since then, cooperation has been ongoing between the two countries in various fields including political, economic, infrastructure, trade, education, culture, and people-to-people relations.

title: Nepal Police Arrest 65 for Disturbing Communal Harmony - Ratopati
description: Nepal Police Arrest 65 for Disturbing Communal Harmony  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Nepal Police have arrested 65 people involved in activities that disturb communal and social harmony. They were taken into custody from various 7 districts of the Terai from July 28 to 9 AM today.

Police have increased their activeness to control the communal tension and attempts to disrupt social harmony seen in the districts of Terai for the past few days. According to the data released by the Police Headquarters, the highest number of 45 people were arrested from Dhanusha district.

Similarly, 9 people were arrested from Sarlahi, 5 from Siraha, 2 each from Mahottari and Sunsari, and 1 each from Parsa and Saptari. Police have stated that necessary investigation and legal action are being taken against the arrested individuals under the offense against public order or relevant laws.

Nepal Police have also appealed to all citizens not to be involved in any kind of activity spreading communal hatred and to maintain social unity.

title: Nepal Unrest Explained: Why Curfews Are Being Lifted After a Week of Violence in the Southern Plains - Open Magazine
description: Nepal Unrest Explained: Why Curfews Are Being Lifted After a Week of Violence in the Southern Plains  Open Magazine
publisher.title: Open Magazine
full_article:
After days of communal violence, curfews, and heightened security across Nepal's southern plains, authorities have started cautiously relaxing restrictions while launching peace initiatives aimed at restoring normalcy. Here's what happened, why the violence spread, and what the situation looks like now.

What triggered the unrest?

The violence began late Sunday in Dewanganj, Sunsari district, after a dispute over loud DJ music during preparations for the annual Bol Bam pilgrimage to the Saptakoshi River. What started as a local argument quickly escalated into stone-pelting and clashes between two communities. Police responded with batons, tear gas, warning shots and eventually live fire. According to ANI, three people have died in the violence, including one person killed during the initial clashes and another injured protester who later succumbed to his injuries.

Why did the unrest spread?

The clashes in Dewanganj soon spread across several districts in Nepal's southern plains, including Sunsari, Dhanusha and Siraha, prompting local administrations to impose curfews and prohibitory orders. The violence also reached Janakpur, the capital of Madhesh Province, where authorities feared further escalation.

What is the situation now?

Authorities say the security situation has improved sufficiently to begin easing restrictions in several areas. Curfews have been lifted in parts of Sunsari, Janakpur and Lahan, although prohibitory orders remain in force. Gatherings of more than five people, public demonstrations, rallies and processions continue to be banned in many locations. Some sensitive areas, including Golbazar in Siraha, remain under curfew. Officials say further relaxation will depend on regular assessments of the ground situation.

What are 'Harmony Rallies'?

Alongside security measures, local administrations and community leaders have begun organising Harmony Rallies across affected districts. The rallies are intended to promote communal unity and encourage residents to reject violence. An all-party meeting was also held in Janakpur to bring together political leaders and community representatives in an effort to restore trust. Local resident Mohammad Asgar Ali warned that communal divisions could have consequences beyond Nepal, saying preserving harmony remains essential for the country and the wider region. Janakpur Mayor Manoj Kumar Shah said discussions with all communities are continuing to preserve the region's long-standing tradition of coexistence.

What restrictions remain in place?

Although curfews are being eased, authorities have retained several restrictions. Public gatherings, marches, demonstrations and sit-ins remain prohibited in many areas. Essential services—including hospitals, pharmacies, ambulance services, fuel supply, water, milk distribution and air travel—continue to operate. Healthcare workers, journalists, government employees, Nepal Red Cross personnel, pilgrims and passengers travelling to airports are also permitted to move upon producing valid identification. Officials have urged residents to comply with the restrictions, warning that legal action will be taken against anyone violating the orders.

What has Nepal's government said?

Prime Minister Balendra Shah, addressing the nation for the first time since taking office in March, announced the formation of an investigation committee to examine the violence. He promised a fair and transparent inquiry, saying everyone responsible for the clashes would be held accountable under the law. For now, authorities say their immediate focus is to prevent fresh violence while restoring normal life through dialogue, community outreach and carefully calibrated easing of restrictions.

नेपाल केरऽ दक्षिणी मैदानऽ म॑ दिन भर के साम्प्रदायिक हिंसा, कर्फ्यू, आरू सुरक्षा बढ़ाबै के बाद अधिकारियऽ न॑ सावधानीपूर्वक प्रतिबंधऽ म॑ ढील दै के साथ-साथ सामान्यता बहाल करै के उद्देश्य स॑ शांति पहल शुरू करी देल॑ छै । एतय देखू जे की भेल, हिंसा किएक पसरल, आ आब केहन स्थिति अछि.

अशांति के की भड़का देलक?

सप्तकोशी नदी के वार्षिक बोल बम यात्रा के तैयारी के दौरान जोरदार डीजे संगीत के ल क विवाद के बाद रविदिन देर रात सुनसरी जिला के देवांगनज में हिंसा शुरू भेल। जे स्थानीय बहस के रूप में शुरू भेल छल ओ जल्दीए पत्थरबाजी आ दू समुदाय के बीच झड़प में बदलि गेल। पुलिस लाठी, आंसू गैस, चेतावनी गोली आ अंततः लाइव फायरिंग सं जवाब देलक। एएनआई के अनुसार एहि हिंसा मे तीन लोक के मौत भ गेल अछि, जाहि मे शुरुआती झड़प के दौरान एकटा व्यक्ति के मौत भ गेल अछि आओर एकटा घायल प्रदर्शनकारी के बाद मे घायल भ गेल अछि.

ओपन पत्रिका कें विज्ञापन मुक्त अनुभव कें लेल साइन अप करूं प्रीमियम सामग्री आ अंतर्दृष्टि कें निर्बाध पहुंच कें आनंद लिअ. विज्ञापन-मुक्त जाओ

अशांति किएक पसरल?

देवांगंज मे भेल झड़प जल्दिये नेपालक दक्षिणी मैदान मे सुनसरी, धनुषा आ सिराहा सहित कतेको जिला मे पसरल जाहि सँ स्थानीय प्रशासन कर्फ्यू आ निषेधात्मक आदेश लगा देलक। हिंसा मधेश प्रदेशके राजधानी जनकपुरमे सेहो पहुँचल, जतए अधिकारिके आशंका आरो बढ़बाक आशंका छल ।

आब की स्थिति अछि?

अधिकारि सब के कहनाय छनि जे सुरक्षा के स्थिति मे एतेक सुधार भेल अछि जे कई क्षेत्र मे प्रतिबंध के कम करय के काज शुरू भ गेल अछि. सुनसरी, जनकपुर आ लहानके किछु भागमे निषेधाज्ञा हटि गेल अछि, यद्यपि निषेधात्मक आदेश प्रचलित अछि । पांच स बेसी लोक क जुटान, जनप्रदर्शन, रैली आ जुलूस क कईटा स्थान पर रोक जारी अछि। सिराहा के गोलबाजार सहित किछ संवेदनशील इलाका मे कर्फ्यू बनल अछि. अधिकारी के कहनाय छनि जे आओर ढील जमीनी स्थिति के नियमित आकलन पर निर्भर करत.

ओपन पत्रिका नवीनतम संस्करण आब बाहर अछि! भविष्य के हरियर बनाना 23 Jul 2026 - Vol 05 | अंक 30 एकटा टिकाऊ भारत के सुरक्षित करब आब पढ़ू भविष्य के हरियर करब

'हारमोनियम रैली' की होइत अछि ?

सुरक्षा उपाय के साथ-साथ स्थानीय प्रशासन आरू समुदाय के नेता प्रभावित जिला भर मँ हार्मोनियम रैली के आयोजन शुरू करी देलकै । रैली के उद्देश्य सांप्रदायिक एकता के बढ़ावा देना आरू निवासी सिनी क हिंसा क नकारै लेली प्रोत्साहित करना छै । विश्वास बहाल करबाक प्रयास मे राजनीतिक नेता आ समुदायक प्रतिनिधि सभ केँ एक ठाम अनबाक लेल जनकपुर मे सर्वदलीय बैसार सेहो भेल छल । स्थानीय निवासी मोहम्मद असगर अली नेपाल सँ आगू साम्प्रदायिक विभाजन के परिणाम भ सकैत अछि से चेतावनी दैत देश आ व्यापक क्षेत्र के लेल सौहार्द के संरक्षण अनिवार्य बनल अछि । जनकपुरके महापौर मनोज कुमार शाह क्षेत्रके सह-अस्तित्वके दीर्घकालीन परम्पराके संरक्षणके लेल सब समुदायके साथ चर्चा जारी रहल बटैलै ।

अनुशंसित कहानी अरब राष्ट्र न॑ ट्रंप केरऽ गाजा योजना के समर्थन करलकै, फिलिस्तीनी राज्य केरऽ जिद करलकै ट्रंप न॑ कहलकै कि ईरान प॑ हुनकऽ ‘विश्वास खोबै’ लगलऽ छै, कैन्हेंकि ताजा युद्ध के खतरा के बीच परमाणु वार्ता जारी छै बांग्लादेश: अस्थिर प्राधिकरण न॑ बतैलकै: पाकिस्तान केरऽ व्यापक चोटी प॑ निर्मल पुरजा के की होलै ? 105 डॉलर मे तेल? एहि ठाम भारत के विकास... बाजार आओर रुपया के लेल एकर की मतलब भ सकैत अछि

कोन-कोन प्रतिबंध बनल अछि?

हालांकि कर्फ्यू मे आसानी भ रहल अछि, मुदा अधिकारी कईटा प्रतिबंध बरकरार रखने अछि। बहुतो क्षेत्र मे जनसभा, मार्च, प्रदर्शन आ धरना पर रोक बनल अछि। आवश्यक सेवाक-जइ मे अस्पताल, फार्मेसी, एम्बुलेंस सेवाक, ईंधन आपूर्ति, पानी, दूध वितरण आ हवाई यात्रा शामिल छै-संचालित जारी छै. स्वास्थ्य सेवाकर्मी, पत्रकार, सरकारी कर्मचारी, नेपाल रेडक्रस के जवान, तीर्थयात्री आ विमानस्थल पर जाय वाला यात्री के सेहो वैध पहचान पत्र पेश करला पर आवागमन के अनुमति अछि। अधिकारी सब निवासी सब स एहि प्रतिबंध क पालन करबाक आग्रह केलथि अछि, चेतावनी देलथि अछि जे आदेश क उल्लंघन करय वाला के खिलाफ कानूनी कार्रवाई कायल जायत।

नेपालक सरकार की कहलक अछि ?

मार्च म॑ पदभार संभालला के बाद पहलऽ बार राष्ट्र क॑ संबोधित करतें हुअ॑ प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह न॑ हिंसा केरऽ जांच लेली जांच समिति के गठन के घोषणा करलकै । ओ निष्पक्ष आ पारदर्शी जांच के वादा करैत कहलनि जे, एहि झड़प के लेल जिम्मेदार सब गोटे के कानून के तहत जवाबदेह ठहराओल जायत। फिलहाल अधिकारियऽ के कहना छै कि हुनकऽ तत्काल फोकस बातचीत, सामुदायिक आउटरीच आरू सावधानी स॑ कैलिब्रेट करलऽ गेलऽ प्रतिबंधऽ म॑ ढील के माध्यम स॑ सामान्य जीवन क॑ बहाल करै के साथ-साथ ताजा हिंसा क॑ रोकै प॑ छै ।

title: Pakistan resumes Broad Peak search as elite Nepali rescuers join search for Nimsdai - Everest Chronicle
description: Pakistan resumes Broad Peak search as elite Nepali rescuers join search for Nimsdai  Everest Chronicle
publisher.title: Everest Chronicle
full_article:
Pakistani rescuers resumed a major search operation on Broad Peak on Saturday as elite Nepali climbers joined efforts to locate renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja and others still missing after a devastating avalanche swept across the Karakoram peak.

The search restarted early Saturday with high-altitude workers and rescue teams, while helicopters again to survey the avalanche zone from the air, according to Gilgit-Baltistan Police.

The avalanche struck below Lower Camp III, at around 6,600 metres, on Thursday, engulfing a 10-member international climbing team led by Nirmal Purja, the celebrated Nepali mountaineer widely known as Nimsdai.

Rescue teams have since recovered two bodies and a limb from the avalanche debris, but authorities have yet to release a complete official casualty list or confirm the identities of everyone involved.

Officials said the body of Omani climber Nadhira Ahmed Abdullah Al Harthy, recovered from the mountain on Friday, was flown from Skardu to Islamabad on Saturday before being repatriated. The body of Nepali mountain guide Pur Bahadur Gurung, known as "Yukta", remains in Skardu.

A severed limb recovered from the avalanche site is believed to belong to American climber Sarah Mallory Geis

The operation received a boost with the arrival of renowned Nepali climber Mingma David Sherpa, who travelled from Nepal to Pakistan to assist in the search for Purja and the remaining missing climbers.

Another veteran Nepali mountaineer involved in the operation, Mingma Gyalje Sherpa, said his team had located all of the victims except one Pakistani climber. Pakistani authorities, however, have not confirmed that assessment.

"Our helicopter pilots have not seen any bodies during today's aerial search," Irfan Arshad Khan, president of Alpine Club of Pakistan told Everest Chronicle, after Friday search, indicating that ground teams continued to face the difficult task of searching through deep avalanche debris.

Nepali guides who cancelled their K2 expedition voluntarily joined Pakistani rescuers and high-altitude workers in recovery efforts at the mountain's upper camps.

Broad Peak, at 8,047 metres, is the world's 12th-highest mountain and lies in Pakistan's Karakoram range, close to K2.

The avalanche is among the deadliest mountaineering disasters in Pakistan in recent years and has sent shockwaves through the international climbing community.

Purja, a former British soldier and one of the world's most accomplished high-altitude climbers, is best known for climbing all 14 of the world's 8,000-metre peaks in just over six months in 2019, shattering the previous speed record.

In 2021, he led the first team to complete a winter ascent of K2, the world's second-highest mountain, with a group of 10 Nepali climbers. Before stepping onto the summit, the team paused to gather together and sing Nepal's national anthem, a moment widely seen as highlighting the role of Nepali mountaineers in Himalayan climbing.

Purja has since set at least 18 mountaineering world records recognised by Guinness World Records, cementing his reputation as one of the sport's most influential figures.

काराकोरम चोटी पर विनाशकारी हिमस्खलन के बाद प्रख्यात पर्वतारोही निर्मल पुरजा आरू अखनी तलक लापता अन्य लोगऽ के पता लगाबै के प्रयास म॑ कुलीन नेपाली पर्वतारोही सब न॑ शनिदिन ब्रॉड पीक प॑ एगो बड़ऽ खोज अभियान फेरू शुरू करी देलकै ।

गिलगित-बाल्तिस्तान पुलिस के अनुसार, शनिदिन सुबह उच्च ऊँचाई पर काम करै वाला मजदूर आरू बचाव टीम के साथ खोज फेरू शुरू होय गेलै, जबकि हेलीकॉप्टर फेरू हवा स॑ हिमस्खलन क्षेत्र के सर्वेक्षण करै लेली शुरू होय गेलै ।

गुरुवार क॑ लोअर कैंप III के नीचें लगभग ६६०० मीटर के ऊंचाई प॑ हिमस्खलन करी क॑ निम्सदाई के नाम स॑ व्यापक रूप स॑ जानलऽ जाय वाला प्रसिद्ध नेपाली पर्वतारोही निर्मल पुरजा के नेतृत्व म॑ १० सदस्यीय अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पर्वतारोही टीम क॑ घेर लेलकै ।

एकरऽ बाद बचाव टीम न॑ हिमस्खलन केरऽ मलबा स॑ दू लाश आरू एगो अंग बरामद करी लेल॑ छै, लेकिन अधिकारियऽ न॑ अभी तलक पूरा आधिकारिक हताहत सूची जारी नै करलकै आरू नै ही एकरा म॑ शामिल सब के पहचान के पुष्टि नै करलकै ।

अधिकारी सब के कहनाय छनि जे शुक्रदिन पहाड़ सं बरामद ओमानी पर्वतारोही नाधीरा अहमद अब्दुल्लाह अल हार्टी के शव के शनिदिन स्कारडू सं इस्लामाबाद पहुंचाओल गेल छल आओर फेर ओकरा वापस भेजल गेल छल. नेपाली पर्वतमार्गदर्शिका पुर बहादुर गुरुङके शव "युक्ता"के नामसे विख्यात स्कारदुमे रहि गेल अछि ।

हिमस्खलन स्थल सं बरामद एकटा कटल अंग अमेरिकी पर्वतारोही सारा मैलोरी गेस के मानल जा रहल अछि

पुरजा आरू शेष लापता पर्वतारोही के खोज म॑ सहायता लेली नेपाल स॑ पाकिस्तान जाय वाला प्रसिद्ध नेपाली पर्वतारोही मिंगमा डेविड शेर्पा के आगमन स॑ ई अभियान क॑ बढ़ावा मिललै ।

अभियान मे शामिल एकटा आओर दिग्गज नेपाली पर्वतारोही मिंगमा ग्यालजे शेर्पा कहलनि जे, हुनकर टीम एकटा पाकिस्तानी पर्वतारोही के छोड़ि सबटा पीड़ित के पता लगा लेलक अछि। पाकिस्तानी अधिकारी हालांकि ओहि आकलन क पुष्टि नहि केलथि अछि।

पाकिस्तान केरऽ अल्पाइन क्लब केरऽ अध्यक्ष इरफान अरशद खान न॑ शुक्रवार क॑ खोज के बाद एवरेस्ट क्रॉनिकल क॑ बतैलकै कि हमरऽ हेलीकॉप्टर पायलट न॑ आज केरऽ हवाई तलाशी के दौरान कोनो शव नै देखल॑ छै, जेकरा स॑ ई संकेत मिलै छै कि जमीनी टीम क॑ गहरा हिमस्खलन केरऽ मलबा के माध्यम स॑ खोज करै के कठिन काम के सामना करना जारी छै ।

अपनऽ के२ अभियान रद्द करै वाला नेपाली गाइड न॑ स्वेच्छा स॑ पाकिस्तानी बचावकर्ता आरू उच्च ऊंचाई प॑ काम करै वाला मजदूरऽ के साथ मिल क॑ पहाड़ केरऽ ऊपरी शिविरऽ म॑ बरामदगी के प्रयास करलकै ।

८,०४७ मीटर केरऽ ब्रॉड पीक दुनिया केरऽ १२वां सबसें ऊंचऽ पहाड़ छेकै आरू पाकिस्तान केरऽ काराकोरम श्रृंखला म॑ स्थित छै, जे के२ के नजदीक छै ।

ई हिमस्खलन पाकिस्तान म॑ हाल केरऽ सालऽ म॑ घटित पर्वतारोहण आपदा म॑ स॑ एक छै आरू अंतरराष्ट्रीय पर्वतारोही समुदाय के माध्यम स॑ सदमा के लहर भेजलकै ।

पूर्व ब्रिटिश सैनिक आरू दुनिया केरऽ सबसें कुशल उच्च ऊंचाई प॑ चलै वाला म॑ स॑ एक पुरजा २०१९ म॑ दुनिया केरऽ ८,००० मीटर केरऽ सब १४ चोटी प॑ छह महीना स॑ कुछ अधिक समय म॑ चढ़ै लेली जानलऽ जाय छै, जेकरा स॑ पहलऽ गति के रिकॉर्ड क॑ तोड़ी देलऽ गेलै ।

२०२१ मे ओ १० नेपाली पर्वतारोही के समूह के साथ विश्व के दोसर सबसँ ऊँच पर्वत के२ के शीतकालीन आरोहण पूरा करय वाला पहिल टीम के नेतृत्व केने छल । शिखर पर कदम रखबा स पहिने टीम एक ठाम जमा भ नेपाल क राष्ट्रगान गाबय लेल रुकि गेल, जेकरा व्यापक रूप स हिमालयी पर्वतारोहण मे नेपाली पर्वतारोही क भूमिका कए उजागर करबाक रूप मे देखल जाइत अछि।

एकरऽ बाद पुरजा न॑ कम स॑ कम १८ पर्वतारोहण केरऽ विश्व रिकॉर्ड बनैल॑ छै जेकरा गिनीज वर्ल्ड रिकॉर्ड न॑ मान्यता देल॑ छै, जेकरा स॑ हुनकऽ प्रतिष्ठा ई खेल केरऽ सबस॑ प्रभावशाली हस्ती म॑ स॑ एक के रूप म॑ मजबूत होय गेलऽ छै ।

title: After 33 months in Ukraine, Nepali PoW clings to hope for freedom - The Himalayan Times
description: After 33 months in Ukraine, Nepali PoW clings to hope for freedom  The Himalayan Times
publisher.title: The Himalayan Times
full_article:
KATHMANDU, JULY 31

A 24-year-old Nepali man from Rolpa district who has been held as a prisoner of war (PoW) since late 2023 has described how limited opportunities at home, the high cost of studying in Russia and misleading promises about rear-area duties drew him into the Russian army - and how, more than two-and-a-half years later, he simply wants to leave captivity, whether for Russia or Nepal.

Related Articles Fugitive escapes Central Jail during Gen-Z protests, arrested after 10 months in Sarlahi 11-year-old boy driving pickup truck crashes into group of Thai monks, killing 8

Pratik Pun, an only son from Rolpa district with no prior military or law enforcement experience in Nepal, is currently being held in a PoW camp in the Lviv region. He was apprehended by Ukrainian forces in November 2023.

Pun arrived in Russia in June 2023 at the recommendation of a relative from his village who was already there, intending to study and work. His departure came just six months after his father died, leaving him as the primary bread winner, along with his mother and three sisters, two of whom are married. "It cost me about Rs 500,000 to travel to Russia," he stated in an exclusive Zoom meeting with THT.

Pun, seeking financial opportunities, applied to the Russian army with a friend in September 2023. Despite the presence of a translator during the signing, the contract was written in Russian, and the recruits were unable to understand its contents.

Pun was expecting an annual salary of around $46,000, Russian citizenship and an assignment strictly limited to rear-area support, such as transporting supplies and assisting wounded soldiers, based on assurances from recruiters and military friends.

Instead, after only about two weeks of basic training, which he described as 'easy and simple,' Pun was unexpectedly deployed to the front lines. He was captured by Ukrainian forces shortly thereafter in November 2023.

By the time of the interview, he had spent roughly 32 or 33 months as a prisoner of war in a camp in western Ukraine's Lviv region. Pun expressed satisfaction with his treatment, saying, "Things are good ... there aren't any complaints."

While phone calls are prohibited, he maintains occasional contact with his family in Nepal through letters facilitated by the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). Pun revealed he has had no recent contact with Nepali diplomatic officials, recalling only a brief meeting with an individual acting as an interpreter in Kyiv roughly two years prior.

With anticipated prisoner exchanges failing to materialise, Pun expressed a desperate desire for release, stating that he is willing to be repatriated to either Nepal or Russia just to leave the facility.

He urged Nepal government to open formal diplomatic channels to secure the release of himself and approximately nine other Nepali nationals who are being held in similar circumstances. "Take some actions and bring us back to the country through whatever process necessary," Pun pleaded with Nepali authorities.

title: Closed for a decade, Godavari Marble stands as a symbol of Nepal’s untapped mineral potential - Khabarhub
description: Closed for a decade, Godavari Marble stands as a symbol of Nepal’s untapped mineral potential  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: A decade after the Supreme Court ordered the closure of the Godavari Marble Industries in Lalitpur over environmental concerns, the once-thriving factory now lies abandoned, its idle machinery and crumbling infrastructure reflecting the broader challenges facing Nepal’s mining sector.

For former employee Ramananda Chaudhary, memories of the factory remain vivid. Having worked at the industry since 1988, he still recalls every corner of the plant and the work that once kept it running around the clock.

Established in 1966, the factory was one of Nepal’s pioneering marble industries. According to Chaudhary, it operated six days a week, producing marble for domestic use and exports to India, Bangladesh and Pakistan before its operating licence was revoked by the Supreme Court on April 16, 2015, citing environmental impacts.

“We have grown old here. I wish the factory could have continued through an alternative arrangement. It would have benefited both the government and future generations,” Chaudhary said.

Another former worker, Hem Bahadur Gurung, said the closure left behind equipment that has deteriorated beyond practical use.

“Four truckloads of marble used to leave the factory every day. Now even repairing the machinery would cost millions of rupees,” he said.

While the Godavari Marble Industries has become part of history, Nepal continues to possess significant mineral resources. According to the Department of Mines and Geology, 63 types of minerals have been identified across the country.

Department spokesperson Narayan Banskota said 171 permits have been issued for mineral exploration and extraction. Of these, 104 are for exploration of 25 different minerals, while 167 permits cover the extraction of 19 mineral types, with limestone accounting for the majority.

He said interest in exploring copper and other metallic minerals has increased, but Nepal lacks the technical expertise and manpower needed for exploration and processing.

“The department does not have the capacity to fully explore and process metallic minerals. Private companies carry out much of the exploration, and foreign collaboration is often required to determine commercially viable reserves,” Banskota said.

He believes Nepal has strong revenue potential from the mining sector but said immediate returns are more likely from non-metallic minerals such as granite, dolomite and slate, which require lower investment and simpler technology than metallic minerals.

Banskota also highlighted the shortage of skilled professionals in the sector, noting that Nepal does not have a university offering specialised mining education. Many students study abroad but are often reluctant to return due to limited career opportunities and incentives.

He said prioritising the extraction and commercialisation of easily accessible minerals could help reduce imports while strengthening Nepal’s domestic mining industry.

काठमांडू : सर्वोच्च न्यायालय द्वारा पर्यावरण सरोकार के ललितपुर के गोदावरी संगमरमर उद्योग बंद करय के आदेश देला के एक दशक बाद एक समय में संपन्न फैक्ट्री आब परित्यक्त पड़ल अछि, ओकर बेकार मशीनरी आ टुटैत बुनियादी ढांचा नेपाल के खनन क्षेत्र के सामने आबय वाला व्यापक चुनौती के दर्शाबैत अछि.

पूर्व कर्मचारी रामानन्द चौधरी लेल फैक्ट्री क याद जीवंत अछि। 1988 स एहि इंडस्ट्री मे काज केलाक बाद हुनका एखनो एहि प्लांट क हर कोना आओर ओ काज याद अछि जे कहियो एकरा चौबीसों घंटा चलैत छल।

1966 मे स्थापित ई कारखाना नेपाल के अग्रणी संगमरमर उद्योग मे सं एक छल. चौधरी के अनुसार ई सप्ताह में छह दिन घरेलू उपयोग के लेल संगमरमर के उत्पादन करैत छल आ भारत, बांग्लादेश आ पाकिस्तान के निर्यात करैत छल, ताहि सं पहिने 16 अप्रैल, 2015 के सुप्रीम कोर्ट द्वारा पर्यावरणीय प्रभाव के हवाला दैत एकर संचालन लाइसेंस निरस्त क देल गेल छल.

चौधरी कहलनि जे, हम सब एतय बूढ़ भ गेल छी, काश वैकल्पिक व्यवस्था के माध्यम स फैक्ट्री आगू बढ़ैत।

एकटा आओर पूर्व कार्यकर्ता हेम बहादुर गुरुंग कहलनि जे, बंद भेला सं एहन उपकरण छोड़ि गेल अछि जे व्यावहारिक उपयोग सं बाहर भ गेल अछि।

ओ कहलनि जे, पहिने रोज चारि ट्रक भरि संगमरमर फैक्ट्री सं बाहर निकलैत छल, आब मशीनरी के मरम्मत मे सेहो लाखों रुपया खर्च होइत छल।

गोदावरी संगमरमर उद्योग इतिहासक अंग बनि गेल अछि, नेपाल मे महत्वपूर्ण खनिज संसाधन बनल अछि । खान आरू भूविज्ञान विभाग के अनुसार देश भर मँ 63 प्रकार के खनिज के पहचान करलौ गेलौ छै ।

विभाग क प्रवक्ता नारायण बांस्कोटा कहला जे खनिज खोज आ निकासी क लेल 171 परमिट जारी कैल गेल अछि। एहि मे स 104 25 अलग-अलग खनिज क खोज क लेल अछि, जखन कि 167 परमिट मे 19 प्रकार क खनिज क निष्कर्षण शामिल अछि, जाहि मे चूना पत्थर क बहुमत अछि।

ओ कहलनि जे, तांबा आ अन्य धातुक खनिजक खोज मे रुचि बढ़ल अछि, मुदा नेपाल मे अन्वेषण आ प्रसंस्करण लेल आवश्यक तकनीकी विशेषज्ञता आ जनशक्तिक अभाव अछि।

बांस्कोटा नँ कहलकै, “विभाग मँ धातु के खनिज के पूरा तरह स॑ खोज आरू संसाधित करै के क्षमता नै छै ।निजी कंपनी सिनी के खोज के बहुत हिस्सा छै, आरू व्यावसायिक रूप स॑ व्यवहार्य भंडार के निर्धारण लेली अक्सर विदेशी सहयोग के जरूरत होय छै ।

हुनकऽ मानना ​​छै कि नेपाल म॑ खनन क्षेत्र स॑ राजस्व केरऽ मजबूत संभावना छै लेकिन तत्काल रिटर्न केरऽ संभावना ग्रेनाइट, डोलोमाइट आरू स्लेट जैसनऽ गैर-धातु खनिज स॑ अधिक छै, जेकरा लेली धातु खनिज के तुलना म॑ कम निवेश आरू सरल तकनीक के जरूरत छै ।

बांस्कोटा एहि क्षेत्र मे कुशल पेशेवरक कमी पर सेहो प्रकाश देलनि, नेपाल मे विशेष खनन शिक्षा देबय वाला विश्वविद्यालय नहि अछि. बहुत सं छात्र विदेश मे पढ़ाई करय छै मुदा कैरियर कें सीमित अवसर आ प्रोत्साहन कें कारण अक्सर वापसी सं हिचकिचाय छै.

ओ कहलनि जे, आसानी सं सुलभ खनिज के निष्कर्षण आ व्यावसायिकरण के प्राथमिकता देला सं आयात कम करय मे मदद मिल सकैत अछि आ संगहि नेपाल के घरेलू खनन उद्योग के मजबूती सेहो मिल सकैत अछि.

title: Professor Khnal: Nepal Lacks Responsibility in Politics, Faces Multiple Crises - Ratopati
description: Professor Khnal: Nepal Lacks Responsibility in Politics, Faces Multiple Crises  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Prof. Krishna Khanal has stated that Nepal lacks the culture of taking responsibility in politics and the country is going through a state of multiple crises. Speaking at an interaction program on the interrelationship between society and politics, he commented that political parties, instead of objectively reviewing the defeats they suffered in elections, tend to evade responsibility by blaming others.

Defining the current state of the country as 'multiple crises', he accused the government of only trying to temporarily suppress problems instead of finding permanent solutions. Citing the agreement with meter-interest victims and the incidents in Devanaganj as examples, he said that the problems have only been slowed down but not addressed. He claimed that the slowing down of problems is not a solution.

Questioning the character of political parties, Prof. Khanal asserted that no party seriously analyzes why it lost; instead, the tendency to evade responsibility by citing internal sabotage or other external reasons is prevalent. He said that although researchers understand the real reasons for defeat, there is no environment in society and political circles to listen to and accept them. Expressing dissatisfaction with the academic environment of universities, he stated that the relationship between teaching and research has been broken. Khanal also informed that he is currently studying the political socialization of the new generation and the dimensions of current political changes.

According to Prof. Khanal, when problems stop being resolved by established institutions and defined processes, only then do they take the form of a crisis. He warned that since the current problems have only been slowed down instead of being resolved, they can flare up again at any time.

काठमांडू। प्रो. समाज आरू राजनीति के बीच के अंतर्संबंध प आयोजित एगो बातचीत कार्यक्रम मँ बोलतें हुअय हुनी टिप्पणी करलकै कि राजनीतिक दल चुनाव मँ मिललौ हार के निष्पक्ष समीक्षा करै के बजाय दोसरौ क दोषी ठहराबै के जिम्मेदारी स॑ बचै के प्रवृत्ति रखै छै ।

देश केरऽ वर्तमान स्थिति क॑ ‘बहुसंकट’ के रूप म॑ परिभाषित करतें हुअ॑ हुनी सरकार प॑ आरोप लगैलकै कि हुनी स्थायी समाधान खोजै के बजाय खाली अस्थायी तौर प॑ समस्या क॑ दबाबै के कोशिश करी रहलऽ छै । मीटर-ब्याज पीड़ित के संग भेल समझौता आ देवनागंज के घटना के उदाहरण दैत ओ कहलनि जे, समस्या के मात्र धीमा कएल गेल अछि मुदा ओकर समाधान नहि भेल अछि। ओ दावा केलथि जे समस्या कए धीमा करब कोनो समाधान नहि अछि।

राजनीतिक दल के चरित्र पर सवाल उठबैत प्रो.खनाल एहि बात पर जोर देलनि जे कोनो पार्टी गंभीरता सं विश्लेषण नहिं करैत अछि जे ओ किएक हारल; बल्कि आंतरिक तोड़फोड़ या अन्य बाहरी कारण के हवाला द क जिम्मेदारी स बचय के प्रवृत्ति प्रचलित अछि | ओ कहलनि जे, भले ही शोधकर्ता हार के असली कारण के समझै छै, लेकिन समाज आरू राजनीतिक हलका में ओकरा सुनै आरू स्वीकार करै के माहौल नै छै। विश्वविद्यालयऽ के शैक्षणिक माहौल स॑ असंतोष व्यक्त करतें हुअ॑ हुनी कहलकै कि शिक्षण आरू शोध के बीच के संबंध टूटी गेलऽ छै । खनाल ई भी जानकारी देलकै कि हुनी अभी नया पीढ़ी के राजनीतिक समाजीकरण आरू वर्तमान राजनीतिक परिवर्तन के आयाम के अध्ययन करी रहलऽ छै ।

प्रो.खनाल के अनुसार जखन समस्या के समाधान स्थापित संस्था आ परिभाषित प्रक्रिया द्वारा बंद भ जायत अछि तखनहि ओ संकट के रूप लैत अछि | ओ चेतावनी देलनि जे चूँकि वर्तमान समस्याक समाधानक बदला मात्र धीमा कयल गेल अछि, तेँ कहियो फेर सँ भड़कि सकैत अछि।

full_article:
We wish to reiterate, in the clearest possible terms, that if Nepal is to achieve sustainable economic growth and long-term prosperity, tourism remains its strongest and most viable foundation. Many nations around the world have attained economic advancement through the prudent utilization of their natural resources, minerals, industries, and other national assets. In Nepal's context, however, our current economic and technological capacity does not yet permit the immediate large-scale extraction and commercialization of minerals, petroleum, or other natural resources. Tourism, on the other hand, is a sector in which the State can generate substantial economic benefits by ensuring effective policies, adequate infrastructure, security, and diplomatic support.

Nepal is uniquely blessed with extraordinary natural wealth. Our mountains, hills, rivers, and pristine landscapes form the country's identity before the world. Mountain tourism, in particular, has witnessed remarkable international growth in recent years and possesses immense potential to become the backbone of Nepal's economy.

At such a critical time, when internationally renowned climbers and Nepali citizens—individuals who have dedicated their lives, expertise, hard work, reputation, and invaluable contributions to the advancement of Nepal's mountaineering and tourism sector—have become victims of an avalanche on foreign soil, the Government of Nepal's diplomatic capability, rescue coordination, and constitutional responsibility toward its citizens are being put to a true test. Unfortunately, the response witnessed thus far has fallen short of the level of initiative, coordination, and urgency expected from the State.

The Constitution of Nepal guarantees every citizen the fundamental rights to life, security, equal treatment, and protection by the State. The Government's constitutional responsibility cannot vary based on an individual's status, influence, or financial standing. From the Prime Minister to an ordinary citizen, every Nepali deserves equal protection under the Constitution. It is precisely during times of crisis that these constitutional obligations must be demonstrated through decisive action.

Despite the willingness and preparedness of Nepal's private sector and tourism entrepreneurs to mobilize internationally recognized Nepali rescue pilots, rescue teams, and necessary aviation resources through their own initiatives, the failure to secure timely diplomatic coordination, official authorization, and institutional facilitation reflects a serious institutional weakness within the State mechanism. Such circumstances raise significant concerns regarding the Government of Nepal's diplomatic responsiveness, coordination capacity, and decision-making process in safeguarding its citizens during international emergencies. In times of crisis, it is the State—not the private sector—that is expected to lead with decisive and effective action. Regrettably, the current situation presents the opposite picture.

Therefore, we respectfully yet firmly urge the Government of Nepal, the Right Honourable Prime Minister, the Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the concerned Nepali diplomatic missions to take the following immediate actions:

Initiate high-level diplomatic coordination without delay with the Government of Pakistan, its Ministry of Foreign Affairs, security agencies, and all relevant authorities.

Mobilize all available international rescue experts, experienced mountaineers, local rescue teams, and every available resource necessary to expedite and strengthen the ongoing search and rescue operation.

If required, undertake all necessary diplomatic and administrative initiatives to deploy Nepali helicopters, world-renowned Nepali rescue pilots, and technical rescue capabilities, including Long Line Rescue, wherever operationally feasible.

Regardless of whether the affected Nepali citizens are found alive or deceased, ensure that verified official information regarding their status is communicated promptly, and that every necessary measure is undertaken to repatriate them to Nepal with dignity and respect.

If necessary, mobilize Nepal Airlines and all available State resources to demonstrate, through concrete action, the Government's constitutional responsibility toward its citizens.

This appeal is not intended as political criticism. Rather, it represents the collective voice of Nepal's citizens and tourism community, reminding the State of its constitutional obligation toward its people. The manner in which the Government responds today will not only determine public confidence at home but will also significantly influence the international community's trust in Nepal's mountaineering industry and the country's global reputation. We therefore earnestly request the Right Honourable Prime Minister, the Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and all concerned authorities to treat this matter not as an ordinary incident but as a matter of national responsibility. Tourism represents Nepal's future, and protecting the lives, dignity, and welfare of those who form the backbone of Nepal's mountaineering and tourism industry must remain the State's foremost responsibility.
